primary.desc: flange top face (stadium plate top around the cups)
primary.why: flange plate top: the plate's underside (not scanned) seats on the tank; the top is the largest clean moulded flat, parallel to it, and every cup, boss and ear rises from it

xy.why: the two valve cups are the functional features; their axes define the pitch line. Band z 1.2-3.6 = the cleanest wall band (higher bands carry +/-0.15 mm scan ripple on the translucent wall)
second cup axis; origin = midpoint of the two cup axes (combine=midpoint)

origin.definition: midpoint of cup A and cup B axes ∩ flange top face

clock.desc: cup A axis -> cup B axis along +X
clock.why: the part's long axis is the line through the two cup (valve) axes; fourier_mass n=2 was biased 0.7 deg by the asymmetric necks/ears (first pass)
